pages.title: Cosmological Constant
pages.text: Lambda, the energy density of empty space itself, which drives the accelerating expansion of the universe. Einstein added it, removed it, and called it his biggest blunder; the sky put it back. Bottled, it is a faint pressure that pushes my hands apart.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Aiming a Dark Matter Lens at empty space in the Dark Energy Siphon, I focused the expansion itself rather than any matter. The siphon drew off a measurable amount of vacuum energy, constant no matter how much I took.
